relevance.rationale: Defines sign-determined non-abelian Ad-twisted Reidemeister torsion for knot exteriors and proves equality with the symplectic volume form on the SU(2)-character variety.

keyResults.statement: For any mu-regular SU(2) representation of a knot group in S^3, the sign-determined non-abelian Reidemeister torsion equals the Casson-Lin-Heusener volume form on the character variety.
keyResults.useForFolio: Supplies sign determination and symplectic character-variety measure interpretation for non-abelian knot torsion.
